pli-tv-kd14:4.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā dabbamallaputtena jātiyā sattavassena arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.3: yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ, sabbaṃ tena anuppattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.4: natthi cassa kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ, katassa vā paticayo.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.5: atha kho āyasmato dabbassa mallaputtassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.6: mayā kho jātiyā sattavassena arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.7: yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ, sabbaṃ mayā anuppattaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.8: natthi ca me kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ, katassa vā paticayo.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.9: kinnu kho ahaṃ saṅghassa veyyāvaccaṃ kareyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.10: atha kho āyasmato dabbassa mallaputtassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.11: “yannūnāhaṃ saṅghassa senāsanañca paññapeyyaṃ bhattāni ca uddiseyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.1: atha kho āyasmā dabbo mallaputto sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā dabbo mallaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.3: “idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.5: yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ sabbaṃ mayā anuppattaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.6: natthi ca me kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ, katassa vā paticayo.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.7: kinnu kho ahaṃ saṅghassa veyyāvaccaṃ kareyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.9: “yannūnāhaṃ saṅghassa senāsanañca paññāpeyyā, bhattāni ca uddiseyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.10: icchāmahaṃ bhante saṅghassa senāsanañca paññāpetuṃ, bhattāni ca uddisitunti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.12: tena hi tvaṃ dabba, saṅghassa senāsanañca paññapehi, bhattāni ca uddisāhī”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.13: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā dabbo mallaputto bhagavato paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.2: tena hi bhikkhave saṅgho dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañca bhattuddesakañca sammannatu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.5: yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.7: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañca bhattuddesakañca sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.10: saṅgho āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañca bhattuddesakañca sammannati.
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.11: yassāyasmato khamati āyasmato dabbassa mallaputtassa senāsanapaññāpakassa ca bhattuddesakassa ca sammuti. so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.13: sammato saṅghena āyasmā dabbo mallaputto senāsanapaññāpako ca bhattuddesako ca.
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.14: khamati saṅghassa. tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti .
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.1: sammato ca panāyasmā dabbo mallaputto sabhāgānaṃ sabhāgānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.2: ye te bhikkhū suttantikā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.4: ye te bhikkhū vinayadharā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.6: ye te bhikkhū dhammakathikā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.8: ye te bhikkhū jhāyino tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.10: ye te bhikkhū tiracchānakathikā kāyadaḍḍhibahulā viharanti, tesampi ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.12: yepi te bhikkhū vikāle āgacchanti, tesampi tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā teneva ālokena senāsanaṃ paññāpeti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.15: te āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.17: te āyasmā dabbo mallaputto evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.20: “amhākaṃ āvuso dabba gijjhakūṭe pabbate senāsanaṃ paññāpehi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.22: amhākaṃ āvuso isigilipasse kāḷasilāyaṃ senāsanaṃ paññapehi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.23: amhākaṃ āvuso vebhārapasse sattapaṇṇiguhāyaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpehi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.24: amhākaṃ āvuso sītavane sappasoṇḍikapabbhāre senāsanaṃ paññāpehi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.30: amhākaṃ āvuso maddakucchismiṃ migadāye senāsanaṃ paññāpehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.31: tesaṃ āyasmā dabbo mallaputto tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā aṅguliyā jalamānāya purato purato gacchati.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.32: tepi teneva ālokena āyasmato dabbassa mallaputtassa piṭṭhito piṭṭhito gacchanti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.33: tesaṃ āyasmā dabbo mallaputto evaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.34: ayaṃ mañco, idaṃ pīṭhaṃ, ayaṃ bhisi, idaṃ bimbohanaṃ, idaṃ vaccaṭṭhānaṃ, idaṃ passāvaṭṭhānaṃ, idaṃ pānīyaṃ, idaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ, ayaṃ kattaradaṇḍo, idaṃ saṅghassa katikasaṇṭhānaṃ, imaṃ kālaṃ pavisitabbaṃ, imaṃ kālaṃ nikkhamitabbanti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.35: tesaṃ āyasmā dabbo mallaputto evaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpetvā punadeva veḷuvanaṃ paccāgacchati.
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.1: tena kho pana samayena mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū navakā ceva honti appapuññā ca.
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.2: yāni saṅghassa lāmakāni senāsanāni tāni tesaṃ pāpuṇanti lāmakāni ca bhattāni.
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.3: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe manussā icchanti therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhisaṅkhārikaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ dātuṃ –
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.7: te pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā there bhikkhū pucchanti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.8: ‘tumhākaṃ āvuso bhattagge kiṃ ahosi, tumhākaṃ kiṃ ahosī’ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.10: ‘amhākaṃ āvuso sappi ahosi. telaṃ ahosi. uttaribhaṅgaṃ ahosī’ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.1: tena kho pana samayena kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati saṅghassa catukkabhattaṃ deti niccabhattaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.3: aññe odanena pucchanti, aññe sūpena pucchanti, aññe telena pucchanti, aññe uttaribhaṅgena pucchanti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.4: tena kho pana samayena kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino bhattaṃ svātanāya mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.5: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati ārāmaṃ agamāsi kenacideva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.6: so yenāyasmā dabbo mallaputto tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.7: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho kalyāṇabhattikaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā dabbo mallaputto dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi, samādapesi, samuttejesi, sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.8: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati āyasmatā dabbena mallaputtena dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.9: kassa bhante amhākaṃ ghare svātanāya bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhanti?
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.10: mettiyabhummajakānaṃ kho gahapati bhikkhūnaṃ tumhākaṃ ghare svātanāya bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhanti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.11: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati anattamano ahosi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.12: kathaṃ hi nāma pāpabhikkhū amhākaṃ ghare bhuñjissantīti. gharaṃ gantvā dāsiṃ āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.13: “ye je sve bhattikā āgacchanti, te koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena parivisā”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.14: “evaṃ ayyāti kho sā dāsī kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.2: “hiyyo kho āvuso amhākaṃ kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.3: sve amhe kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati saputtadāro upatiṭṭhitvā parivisissati:
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.4: aññe odanena pucchissanti. aññe sūpena pucchissanti. aññe telena pucchissanti. aññe uttaribhaṅgena pucchissantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.5: te teneva somanassena na cittarūpaṃ rattiyā supiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.6: atha kho mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.7: addasā kho sā dāsī mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū dūratova āgacchante.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.8: disvāna koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.11: nissaṃsayaṃ kho na tāva bhattaṃ siddhaṃ bhavissati yathā mayaṃ koṭṭhake nisīdāpiyāmāti
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.12: atha kho sā dāsī kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena upagañchi
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.17: ‘ye je sve bhattikā āgacchanti, te koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena parivisā’ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.20: “hiyyo kho āvuso, kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati ārāmaṃ agamāsi dabbassa mallaputtassa santike.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.21: nissaṃsayaṃ kho mayaṃ dabbena mallaputtena gahapatino antare paribhinnā”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.22: te teneva domanassena na cittarūpaṃ bhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.23: atha kho mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātappaṭikkantā ārāmaṃ gantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭisāmetvā bahārāmakoṭṭhake saṅghāṭipallatthikāya nisīdiṃsu - tuṇhībhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhānā.
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.1: atha kho mettiyā bhikkhunī yena mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.5: tatiyampi kho mettiyā bhikkhunī mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.10: “tathā hi pana tvaṃ bhagini, amhe dabbena mallaputtena viheṭhiyamāne ajjhupekkhasī”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.12: “sace kho tvaṃ bhagini, iccheyyāsi, ajje va bhagavā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ nāsāpeyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.15: “ehi tvaṃ bhagini, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.16: idaṃ bhante, nacchannaṃ nappatirūpaṃ. yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā anupaddavā, sāyaṃ disā sabhayā saītikā saupaddavā.
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.20: evaṃ ayyāti kho mettiyā bhikkhunī mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.21: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho mettiyā bhikkhunī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.22: “idaṃ bhante, nacchannaṃ nappatirūpaṃ. yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā anupaddavā, sāyaṃ disā sabhayā saītikā saupaddavā.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.2: “sarasi tvaṃ dabba, evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ bhikkhunī āhā”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.4: dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.5: “sarasi tvaṃ dabba, evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ bhikkhunī āhā”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.7: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.8: “sarasi tvaṃ dabba, evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ bhikkhunī āhā”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.10: na kho dabba, dabbā evaṃ nibbeṭhenti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.13: “yatohaṃ bhante, jāto nābhijānāmi supinantenapi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitā, pageva jāgaro”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.17: idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.18: atha kho te bhikkhū mettiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nāsesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.19: atha kho mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū te bhikkhū etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.20: “mā āvuso, mettiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nāsetha, na sā kiñci aparajjhati.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.21: amhehi sā ussaṃhitā kupitehi anattamanehi cāvanādhippāyehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.22: “kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso, āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsethā”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.24: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.25: “kathaṃ hi nāma mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsessantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.26: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.27: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsentīti?
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.1: tena hi bhikkhave, saṅgho dabbassa mallaputtassa sativepullappattassa sativinayaṃ detu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.3: tena bhikkhave dabbena mallaputtena saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā, ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā buḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā, ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:

pli-tv-kd14:4.10.5: sohaṃ bhante sativepullappatto saṅghaṃ sativinayaṃ yācāmī”ti.

pli-tv-kd14:14.19.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi tasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anantāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti na cetassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati, anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ubbāhikāya vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.3: sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvute viharati ācāragocara sampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhā padesu.
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.4: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti. tathārūpassa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.

pli-tv-kd14:14.19.7: paṭibalo hoti ubho attapaccatthike aññāpetuṃ assāpetuṃ nijjhāpetuṃ pekkhetuṃ pasīdituṃ pasādetuṃ
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi dasahaṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ ubbāhikāya sammannituṃ.

pli-tv-kd14:14.20.8: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti, na cetassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd14:14.20.9: saṅgho itthannāmañca itthannāmañca bhikkhuṃ sammannati ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.

pli-tv-kd14:14.21.6: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ kārako ukkoṭeti-ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.22.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi tasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne tatrāssa bhikkhu dhammakathiko, tassa neva suttaṃ āgataṃ hoti no suttavibhaṅgo. so atthaṃ asallakkhento vyañjanacchāyāya atthaṃ paṭibāhati. vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena te bhikkhū ñāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.22.4: imassa neva suttaṃ āgataṃ hoti, no suttavibhaṅgo.
pli-tv-kd14:14.22.5: so atthaṃ asallakkhento byañjanacchāyāya atthaṃ paṭibāhati.

pli-tv-kd14:14.24.2: na mayaṃ bhante sakkoma imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ubbāhikāya vūpasametuṃ. saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametūti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ yebhuyyasikāya vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.5: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhayā gatiṃ gaccheyya, gahitāgahitañca jāneyya …pe…

pli-tv-kd14:14.24.25: yāvatikā bhikkhū kammappattā te āgatā honti. chandārahānaṃ chando āhaṭo hoti, sammukhībhūtā na paṭikkosanti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.28: yena dhammena yena vinayena yena satthusāsanena taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati,
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.31: yo ca vivadati yena ca vivadati ubho attapaccatthikā sammukhībhūtā honti,
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.34: yā yebhuyyasikā kammassa kiriyā karaṇaṃ upagamanaṃ ajjhupagamanaṃ adhivāsanā appaṭikkosanā–
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.36: evaṃ vūpasantañce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ kārako ukkoṭeti, ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.1: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyā evaṃ jātaṃ evaṃ samuppannaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.4: assosuṃ kho amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulā therā viharanti bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā paṇḍitā vyattā medhāvino lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.5: te ce therā imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena, evamidaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ suvūpasantaṃ assāti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.6: atha kho te bhikkhū taṃ āvāsaṃ gantvā te there etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.7: “idaṃ bhante adhikaraṇaṃ evaṃ jātaṃ evaṃ samuppannaṃ:
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.8: sādhu bhante therā imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamentu dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena, yathayidaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ suvūpasantaṃ assāti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.10: yathā sāvatthiyā saṅghena adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamitaṃ, tathā suvūpasantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.13: asantuṭṭhā sāvatthiyā saṅghassa adhikaraṇa vūpasamane na, asantuṭṭhā sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ adhikaraṇavūpasamanena.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.14: assosuṃ kho amukasmiṃ kira āvāse tayo therā viharanti …pe…
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.16: eko thero viharati bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.17: so ce thero imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyya dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena, evamidaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ suvūpasantaṃ assāti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.18: atha kho te bhikkhū taṃ āvāsaṃ gantvā taṃ theraṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.19: idaṃ bhante adhikaraṇaṃ evaṃ jātaṃ evaṃ samuppannaṃ,

pli-tv-kd14:14.25.24: atha kho te bhikkhū asantuṭṭhā sāvatthiyā saṅghassa adhikaraṇavūpasamanena, asantuṭṭhā sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ adhikaraṇavūpasamanena, asantuṭṭhā tiṇṇaṃ therānaṃ adhikaraṇavūpasamanena, asantuṭṭhā dvinnaṃ therānaṃ adhikaraṇavūpasamanena, asantuṭṭhā ekassa therassa adhikaraṇavūpasamanena, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ bhagavā etadavoca.

pli-tv-kd14:14.29.20: kimpanāhaṃ evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā puṭṭho na paṭijānissāmī’ti?

pli-tv-kd14:14.29.24: iṅghāyasmā sādhukameva jānāhi. yadi sarasi evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vāti.

pli-tv-kd14:14.29.27: davā me etaṃ vuttaṃ, ravā me etaṃ vuttaṃ.

pli-tv-kd14:14.29.29: tassa kho taṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno tassapāpiyyasikā kammaṃ kātabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd14:14.33.6: idha bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivādāpannānaṃ viharataṃ bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ hoti bhāsitaparikantaṃ.

pli-tv-kd14:14.33.15: sace mayaṃ imāhi āpattīhi aññamaññaṃ kāressāma. siyāpi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷattāya vāḷattāya bhedāya saṃvatteyya.
